_README: Copy to routine.config.json in your private trading repository, and commit it there. It says where `node r3.cjs install` puts the tools and what they talk to. No secret goes in it: the trading routine's environment holds the key as R3_KEYSTORE_JSON and R3_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD, ordinary environment variables that every command in that environment can read (steps/I-setup.md I.2 section 7). Keys starting with an underscore are ignored.
_signerAddress: The bot wallet: it signs, pays gas and holds every position.
_owner: Your own address, the only one the signer's supervised sweeps can ever send to. Must differ from signerAddress.
_allowlist: The signer's policy file, built once with `node <signer path> allowlist-init` (operator-run), committed in your private copy, and its sha256.
_planner: rpcGapMs and parallel pace the planner's RPC reads.
_dirs: Where the planner and helper, the signer, the key files and the signer's lock and log go. All must be outside the project folder. In the trading repository leave keysDir at ~/.r3-signer-keys: the trading routine's deny rule Read(~/.r3-signer-keys/**) names that folder. install writes the key files there only when R3_KEYSTORE_JSON and R3_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD are both set; elsewhere put keystore.json and password there yourself, or the signer cannot sign.
_git: Who commits the run records, and to which branch, when a routine pushes them (--push).
